name: citeproof
description: Local audit trail for AI-assisted systematic reviews: PRISMA counts, screening decisions, evidence and risk-of-bias records, DOI and quote checks.
long_description:
CiteProof records and checks what your research agent supplies during a systematic review: the protocol, PRISMA 2020 search and screening counts, extracted evidence, risk-of-bias judgements, claim support, and citation checks, then exports the whole audit trail as one document.

Everything runs on your computer. Review data is stored in a local SQLite database (default `~/.citeproof-mcp`) and is never uploaded. The only network calls made by the server are DOI lookups in `verify_dois` (Crossref, then doi.org). The extension does not search the literature, read papers or make scientific judgements for you, and it contains no language model.

The extension runs the same Node launcher as the npm package and includes the Python server source. The launcher uses uvx when it is present, otherwise a suitable local Python with the included server source, and only then installs uv and downloads the server wheel, which requires network access.

tools.name: review_create
tools.description: Start a new review and get the review_id every other review tool needs.

tools.name: review_list
tools.description: List existing reviews, newest first, to recover a review_id.

tools.name: verify_dois
tools.description: Check that DOIs exist in a registry (Crossref, then doi.org) and are not retracted.

tools.name: resolve_citations
tools.description: Match the inline citations in a text against your reference list, and find references never cited.

tools.name: lint_prose
tools.description: Advisory style check of report prose with fixed rules.

tools.name: claim_record
tools.description: Record your judgement of whether one paper supports one claim, and check the quote you rely on.

tools.name: claim_report
tools.description: Summarise the recorded claim judgements and list the ones that need attention.

tools.name: rob_record
tools.description: Record one risk-of-bias domain judgement for one paper and check its supporting quote.

tools.name: rob_summary
tools.description: Overall risk-of-bias judgement per paper by the tool's published rule, plus traffic-light table rows.

tools.name: prisma_record_search
tools.description: Log one database or register search for the PRISMA identification box.

tools.name: dedup_papers
tools.description: Find duplicate records deterministically so the PRISMA duplicate count is computed, not guessed.

tools.name: prisma_record_dedup
tools.description: Record a duplicate count you computed elsewhere (replaces any earlier count).

tools.name: screening_record
tools.description: Record one screening decision for one paper; re-sending the same paper_ref, stage and reviewer replaces it.

tools.name: screening_record_many
tools.description: Record up to 500 screening decisions in one all-or-nothing transaction.

tools.name: screening_list
tools.description: List recorded screening decisions, newest first, one page at a time.

tools.name: screening_agreement
tools.description: Cohen's kappa between two reviewers' include/exclude decisions at one stage.

tools.name: prisma_status
tools.description: Compute the PRISMA 2020 flow counts from the recorded searches, dedup and screening decisions.

tools.name: prisma_flow_diagram
tools.description: Render the PRISMA 2020 flow diagram from the counts prisma_status computes.

tools.name: prisma_checklist
tools.description: Keyword check of a report against the 27 PRISMA 2020 items, plus a check of the PRISMA numbers it states.

tools.name: evidence_record
tools.description: Record one evidence-table row (one study, one outcome) with its source quote checked.

tools.name: evidence_table
tools.description: Export the evidence table and report extraction gaps.

tools.name: protocol_record
tools.description: Record or update the review protocol and check that it is complete.

tools.name: review_status
tools.description: One-call overview of a review: what is recorded, what is missing, warnings and the next steps in order.

tools.name: export_bundle
tools.description: Export the whole audit trail as one text document for the review's supplementary material.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where CiteProof keeps its local SQLite records. Leave empty for the default (~/.citeproof-mcp).
